activity_summary: At dinner the loaf was still short of the notch. The board was threepence. You were going back to play Egeon, and you left the desk untouched.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the desk stayed, and went back out.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Showed the loaf short of the notch.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the board and the afternoon.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: it does not reach the notch.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The desk is as I left it.
